description: This file defines the SearchQueryBuilder interface, providing a fluent API to construct immutable SearchQuery objects with options such as sorting, limiting, and pagination.

classes.name: SearchQueryBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder with a fluent API for an immutable SearchQuery.

methods.name: sortAsc
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the given property path to ascending. Replaces existing sort order for the same path. Supports method chaining.

methods.name: sortDesc
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the given property path to descending. Replaces existing sort order for the same path. Supports method chaining.

methods.name: removeSortOptionFor
methods.description: Removes the sort option for the specified property path. Supports method chaining.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets pagination limits with offset and count, where count is capped at 200. Supports method chaining.

methods.name: removeLimitation
methods.description: Removes the pagination limit. Supports method chaining.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns an immutable SearchQuery object based on the current builder state.
